test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven persons – G, M, R, K, L, P and C – are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. The following information is known about them. G is to the immediate right of K, who is third to the left of C. R is adjacent to both C and P. M is not adjacent to G. Who is third to the left of M ?
solution:
Given: Seven persons – G, M, R, K, L, P and C. 

1) G is to the immediate right of K, who is third to the left of C. 

2) R is adjacent to both C and P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51b9ffba00d5bfa34537751d19c27e982e1e6a96b957e42a0ec0db30774b559b.png] 

3) M is not adjacent to G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/171bb47d639aab54427103bb1290bcd10631d9c8003b48f18167d331b0f8ceac.png] 

And, L will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/968afa90cb44ea88f9ccb81dcb224d85cfa0c6d764647f45f42aff744c7f3d29.png] 

So, 'C' is the third to the left of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C"**.
